english.title: Procure miscarriage of woman by poison / instrument
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully

(A)_[administered to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a poison or other noxious thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..),]_
(B)_[caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to take a poison or other noxious thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..),]_
(C)_[used an instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTRUMENT..),]_
(D)_[used **(..SPECIFY MEANS USED OR "MEANS UNKNOWN"..)]_

with intent to procure

(E)_[her miscarriage]_
(F)_[the miscarriage of a woman named **(..SPECIFY NAME..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 58 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
unlawfully administered poison/other noxious thing/caused to take poison/other noxious thing/used
an instrument with intent to procure miscarriage of herself/another woman

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A woman having an abortion does not commit an offence when acting in relation to her own pregnancy, see section 241 of the Crime and Policing Act 2026. For offences committed on or after 29th April 2026 see H102718.
(ii) The woman in this instance does not have to be with child (pregnant).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
